clauses.scope_note: Permission to install and use the Plugin for mortgage refinance inquiries through the listed channels; it does not specify other purposes or channels.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use must be for mortgage refinance inquiries and through Claude Code, the Anthropic plugin directory, or another authorized AI agent marketplace.

clauses.scope_note: Permission covers distributing the Plugin through the specified marketplaces only.
clauses.condition_explanation: Distribution must be through the Anthropic plugin directory or another authorized AI agent marketplace.

clauses.clause_label: Permission to use functionality through AI agents
clauses.scope_note: Permission covers using the Plugin's functionality through AI agents acting for consumers seeking mortgage refinance information.
clauses.condition_explanation: The AI agent must act on behalf of consumers seeking mortgage refinance information.

clauses.scope_note: Modifying the Plugin or creating derivative works of it is prohibited absent prior written consent from Nexus Digital Group LLC.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when prior written consent from Nexus Digital Group LLC has not been obtained.

clauses.clause_label: Restriction on redistributing source files outside authorized marketplaces
clauses.scope_note: The restriction concerns redistribution of the Plugin's source files outside authorized AI agent marketplaces; it does not state a general prohibition on distribution through those marketplaces.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when Plugin source files are redistributed outside authorized AI agent marketplaces without prior written consent from Nexus Digital Group LLC.

clauses.clause_label: Restriction on competing mortgage products or services
clauses.scope_note: Forking the Plugin to create competing mortgage products or services is prohibited absent prior written consent. The text does not state a broader restriction on competition or commercial use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the Plugin is forked to create competing mortgage products or services and prior written consent from Nexus Digital Group LLC has not been obtained.

clauses.clause_label: Restriction on copying skill content into other products
clauses.scope_note: The restriction covers copying the Plugin's skill content into other plugins, AI systems, or software products; it does not state a general prohibition on copying the Plugin for otherwise permitted use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to the specified copying when prior written consent from Nexus Digital Group LLC has not been obtained.

clauses.scope_note: Prohibits unauthorized access to the proprietary pricing and loan origination services to which the Plugin connects; it does not specify authorization criteria or grant access.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when access to either connected proprietary service is unauthorized.

coverage_notes: The supplied text gives specified permissions and restrictions but does not provide a general grant for other activities, purposes, or channels; silence is not treated as permission or prohibition.
The text does not specify attribution, notice, source-provision, copyleft, patent, fees, training, output rights, or general sublicensing terms.
The Plugin's connection to proprietary pricing and loan origination services is mentioned, but authorization requirements and any applicable service terms are not supplied.
Warranty and liability disclaimers, ownership statements, trademark information, and the licensing inquiry contact are omitted as not operative ASC clauses.
